critique: The interface demonstrates strong functional clarity with well-organized controls and clear visual hierarchy, but the execution feels utilitarian and lacks the sensorial richness one would expect from a color harmony tool. The stark contrast between the vibrant color swatches and the austere dark interface creates a disconnect—the design system itself doesn't embody the principles of chromatic harmony it's meant to facilitate, missing an opportunity to use color relationships as part of the UI's own visual language.
